errors.message: Unsupported file type or template version.
Required header is missing or duplicated.
Required value is missing.
Invalid date, timestamp, month or timezone value.
Referenced organization, engagement, project, employee, deliverable or user cannot be resolved.
Duplicate business key exists within the file or target system.
Effective-date range is invalid or overlaps a prohibited existing range.
Value violates the effective policy or workflow-state rule.
Historical approval or confirmation actor is not mapped to an authorized role.
Target month is closed; reopen/version authorization is required.
Record conflicts with the authoritative source for this employee-day or object.
File or row checksum does not match the declared value.
Disallowed sensitive field detected, including salary, markup, rate or payroll data.
Punches cannot be paired deterministically or daily totals are internally inconsistent.
Linear issue is inaccessible or current status cannot prove historical status.
Confirmation evidence lacks a verifiable message/thread identifier or authenticated sender mapping.
Optional value was normalized or truncated according to template rules.
Import batch is no longer in a state that permits commit or rollback.
Prerequisite master or parent record has not been imported.
Unexpected validation or processing error; see correlation ID.
